name: ticker-universe-builder
description: Build evidence-gated native, Global and Global Core universes with validated TradingView exports.

interface.longDescription: Compose audited Global observations from qualified native-market universes and verified references, derive a reviewed Global Core subset preserving all parent duties, or build and maintain fourteen native markets at four depths. Research issuer identities, ETF quality, economic coverage and dated measurements. Python validates contracts and writes portable JSON, TradingView TXT, Markdown and HTML. Global validation checks independent coverage duties, exact source hashes, issuer duplicates and ETF evidence. Pilot scope and source cutoffs remain explicit. Standard library, Python 3.10+, no service or required API key. No return guarantees, allocations or trade execution.
defaultPrompt: Build a US Medium ticker universe using current online evidence, with HTML, Markdown and TradingView exports.
Maintain my existing ticker universe and explain additions, removals and unresolved research.
Expand my qualified Heavy universe to Max with sourced Beta while preserving its theme distribution.
Compose a researched Global universe with issuer deduplication, ETF quality and TradingView TXT exports.
Build a reviewed Global Core subset while preserving all parent coverage duties and ETF quality gates.

publication.release_notes: 0.11.0: reviewed Global Core subsets with pinned qualified parents, preserved coverage and validated TradingView exports.

zh-CN.subtitle: 构建可核验的标的观察池
zh-CN.description: 按行业与主题构建和维护标的观察池，覆盖十四个已审查市场及 Light、Medium、Heavy、Max 四个档位。Agent 研究主营、龙头与补充 Beta，Python 验证证据、保护基础覆盖并生成 TradingView TXT、Markdown、完整离线 HTML、JSON 和验证报告。Max 沿用 Heavy 的主题比例；证据不足会保留诊断和续跑记录。需 Python 3.10+、文件及命令访问能力，最新构建还需在线研究和有日期的市场数据。仅提供观察工具，不提供收益承诺、仓位配置或交易执行。
